children: Gold edges higher in early Asian trade amid better investor sentiment. Gold rose nearly 2% on Monday, rebounding from a one-year low reached in the previous session, supported by a retreat in oil prices that tempered inflation concerns, say Morgan Stanley analysts in a research note. Analysts reckon that $4,000 will be the key level to watch for gold's next movement. Spot gold is 0.1% higher at $3,950.25 an ounce. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
